Specification: This module is a TLC model wrapper around the imported CarTalkPuzzle specification. It defines concrete model-level constants and a constant expression used to evaluate or display a candidate solution, then issues an ASSUME invoking PrintT to print that value during model processing. The file itself does not define the underlying algorithm or puzzle logic; instead, it supplies model data and a debugging or inspection expression for an external specification extended via CarTalkPuzzle.
